content: MK says Bākharzī and Jāmī 'willfully' ignore that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn and Sharaf al-Dīn explicitly rejected organized Sufism as the end of human development and so felt no duty to live as professional Sufis, and that both Ṣāʾin al-Dīn and Jāmī sought to absorb Ibn ʿArabī's teaching but with projects at cross-purposes; MK calls Jāmī's attitude rather adolescent disrespect for the older intellectual guard.
